title: A task gate judges the task, not the recorder's own writes
description: BUG-36: since a run's record lives in the plan shard, the drive's own uncommitted record writes sit inside the tree a task gate judges, and a project check that reads the plan can go red on them alone; the drive then blocks the task. Found by the paid probe probe-f119de55 (session k15p). Fix the class: decide where the recorder's writes stand relative to what a gate judges, and make the drive never charge a red to a task that the recorder's writes alone cause.
desiredOutcome: A red that the drive's own record writes alone cause is never charged to the task; the probe's k15p shape is a case that stays green or is classified as base, and BUG-36 closes.
summary: BUG-36 fixed: the drive's own record writes no longer get a red charged to the task. P171.1 measures the base with the recorder's writes laid over it and makes a kept base not-knowable for a recorder-held red; P171.2 (one delta round from the independent opus review: med regression) keeps paths the task declares out of the overlay and stores recorderHeld/uncarried on the row so only a recorder-caused not-knowable owes a base. Independent review: no high; its med and lows fixed in P171.2. CI release tier green on 9a50413d (45830261501).

tasks.title: The drive never charges a task with a red its own record writes caused

outcome.technical: Design B: a base run carries the recorder's own writes, and only a base that carried them charges the task. Measuring the task gate in a tree whose recorder paths hold committed content (A) was rejected because it changes what every step reads (a validate/gate step would judge the last commit's plan) and a copy of the project lacks its ignored dependencies. B keeps the stamp's recorder exclusion (same recorded_paths set), the clean-tree base rule (the overlay is left out of the dirty digest via run_gate's new dirty_excluded, and dirtyBasis counts it), red-first, and base_red's case-by-case comparison. run-test-gate.py: run_gate records recorderHeld (whether the pre-run porcelain held a recorder write, read through _tree_stamp.dirty_digest's own exclusion). New: lay_recorder_writes/_lay_file/_mirror_dir lay the recorder paths from --recorder-from (default: the project) over --tree before a --base-of run. uncarried(), applied inside base_reading, moves every suite a base would charge to the task into unknown, with a sentence saying why, and sets the verdict to not-knowable unless the base was measured for that red (baseOf) or the red's tree held no recorder write. kept_base_answer does not answer such a red. The --kept-only refusal is reworded. drive-phase.py: base_need returns a third value, the ELSEWHERE_BASE_WHY sentence, when the base recorded for the commit and step set was measured for another red (measured_for). base_measure_due/decided_elsewhere then make a base measurement due even though the start already has a finished mark. _base_in passes --recorder-from from the red's tree. tools/lints/_deps.py: two OTHER_WRITERS rows (lay_recorder_writes, _mirror_dir via run-test-gate._lay_file) with the _PW_RECORDER_OVERLAY reason. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one paragraph in each of the run-test-gate and drive-phase sections. changelog.d/P171.1.fixed.md. Tests: rcw1-rcw5 (block rcw in test_run_test_gate.py, with the shared RECORDER_GATE_SCRIPT fixture: a plan check red on any kept base run the plan names) and rcd1-rcd2 (stage rcd-block in test_drive_phase.py); the bh5 stub was updated to base_need's three-value return. Mutations, each restored and checked with cmp, with __pycache__ purged: rule off reds rcw1/3/4/5 and rcd1/2; rule always fires reds rcw2/3/5 and rcd2 (the twins); overlay off reds rcw4/5 and rcd1/2; dirty_excluded dropped reds rcw3/4/5; kept base answers anyway reds rcw4/5; drive decided_elsewhere off reds rcd1/2; drive base_need branch off reds rcd1/2. Task gate: 2/2 files ok, 1846 cases. Full sweep after the last edit: 196/196 files ok, 20006 cases. ruff exit 0, vermin exit 0. The plan gate refused a heredoc edit to drive-phase.py, verbatim: '[plan gate] A source-file write from a heredoc fed to an interpreter's stdin (python3 - <<EOF …), which is the same capability as python -c and is graded as one bypasses the plan-first gate: tests/plugins/audit/scripts/governance/drive-phase.py (change magnitude 177 > 80) … This path is outside the running task's `files`'. The path was mis-resolved because of a trailing cd tests; the same edits were then made with the Edit tool, which the gate allowed. Dependants: the drive's importers and suites do not call the changed internal signatures (git grep finds none beyond the bh5 stub); run_gate's new parameter defaults to None and its result key is additive; README, execute-task.md and COMPATIBILITY.md names are unchanged (the new flag is not a config key); test_drive_without_model imports unchanged helpers; check-example-ledgers.py is waived and untouched. Cost: one more base measurement for each red a kept base would have charged to the task.
outcome.descriptive: A red that the drive's own uncommitted record writes alone cause is read against a base that carries those writes and classified as red at base (gate-red-base), never charged to the task; a red the task's work causes is still the task's.

tasks.title: The recorder overlay never lays a path the task itself declares, and only a recorder-caused not-knowable owes a base
tasks.description: Review of 9a50413d. (1, med regression) lay_recorder_writes copies every recorded path from the red's tree, including paths the task declares in its own files (real tasks do: plan shards, returns), so a red the task's own plan edit causes is laid into the base and read base-only - the drive then tells the owner the base fails the same cases. Lay only recorder paths outside the task's declared files; an overlapping path keeps the base commit's content. (6, low but false claim + extra cost) recorderHeld is never stored on the run row, so the kept-answer 'held no recorder write' branch cannot fire; and base_need's elsewhere branch fires on any not-knowable, not only one the uncarried rule produced, re-appending a false ELSEWHERE_BASE_WHY each pass. Persist recorderHeld (and the uncarried marker) on the row and key base_need on it. Fix the changelog/guide sentence that a same-case task red stays the task's (true only for a different case).

outcome.technical: (1) run-test-gate.py: lay_recorder_writes(source, tree, rels, declared=()) skips every recorder path an entry of the red work's files covers (_task_outputs.covers, via _declared_rel), at the top level and file by file inside a mirrored directory (_mirror_dir gained rel/declared; a directory absent in source is mirrored as empty, so declared files inside it are kept rather than rmtree'd); _run_base_of reads the files with owned_files(manifest, row phaseId, row taskId) and refuses (E_ASK, nothing ran) when they cannot be read. (6) _evidence_io.py: RECORDER_HELD_KEY and BASE_UNCARRIED_KEY constants; row_for keeps recorderHeld when it is a bool (False kept); _base_red keeps uncarried suites (repo-relative, bounded); RECORD_GRAMMAR gains recorderHeld (_BOOL leaf), _BASE_READING gains uncarried. run-test-gate.py aliases both keys to _evidence_io's. drive-phase.py base_need's elsewhere branch now keys on reading[BASE_UNCARRIED_KEY] instead of verdict == not-knowable. (2) changelog.d/P171.1.fixed.md and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (run-test-gate and drive-phase sections): declared-path rule, recorderHeld/uncarried persisted, and the same-case limit (a task red stays the task's only in a case the recorder's writes leave passing; the reading compares failing cases). Tests: test_run_test_gate rcw6-rcw10 (gate script gains a second plan trigger el3; _recorder_repo takes declared/plan_edit), test__evidence_io rh1-rh2 (new rh-block stage) plus recorderHeld False in _rs_full_result (rs1 demanded it), test_drive_phase rcd3-rcd4. Red-first on the pre-fix code: rcw6 FAIL (verdict base-only, atBase check_ledgers), rcw8 TypeError (no declared kwarg), rcw9/rcw10 FAIL (row drops recorderHeld), rh1/rh2 FAIL, rcd3 FAIL (elsewhere sentence on an unrelated not-knowable). Mutations (each applied once by anchor, restored by copy, cmp identical, __pycache__ purged): M1 top-level declared skip removed -> rcw6,rcw8 red; M2 mirror ignores declared -> rcw8; M3 over-fire any declared skips all -> rcw7,rcw8; M4 row drops recorderHeld -> rh1,rcw9,rcw10; M5 truthy-only keep -> rh1,rcw9; M6 grammar lacks recorderHeld -> rh1; M7 _base_red drops uncarried -> rh2,rcd1,rcd2; M8 base_need keyed on verdict -> rcd3; M9 never elsewhere -> rcd1,rcd2,rcd4. Gates after the last edit: task gate exit 0 (3/3 files ok, 2455 cases); full sweep exit 0 (196/196 files ok, 20015 cases); ruff exit 0; vermin exit 0; release.py changelog-check exit 0. Untested branch: owned_files refusal in _run_base_of (a red whose task the plan no longer holds). Dependants: drive-phase.py, full-gate.py and the importing suites still correct - lay_recorder_writes only gained a defaulted argument, RECORDER_HELD_KEY/UNCARRIED_KEY keep their strings, base_need keeps its signature and return shape; _evidence_io readers (guard-release, close-phase, integrate-task, _invariants, ...) only see two more optional keys, and the published lastRun accepts them (additionalProperties true; rk1/pj1 green); PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and changelog.d changed only in the sentences above.
